WP_DP_1P_SWITCH.Description: Slayer weapons wielded by the elite Skyfighters.

WP_DP_COBALT_SONY.Description: A Slayer's weapon frost-forged with concentrated archonite born in the intense pressures of the Maelstrom.

WP_DP_HP03_MOSSY.Description: Can you hear it on the wind?

WP_DP_HP05_NINJA_00.Description: Get an edge over the enemy.

WP_DP_HP05_NINJA_02.Description: All that blossoms from them is death.

WP_DP_HP06_PIRATE_01.Description: They're said to grow louder when they're about to blast through a Behemoth's hide.

WP_DP_HP06B_ACADEMY_00.Description: Combat repeaters designed by the most brilliant military minds, forged by the finest living smiths in Ostigaard.

WP_DP_HP06B_ACADEMY_01.Description: Multipurpose repeaters designed by the most brilliant military minds, forged by the finest living smiths in Ostigaard.

WP_DP_HP06B_ACADEMY_02.Description: Lethal repeaters designed by the most brilliant military minds, forged by the finest living smiths in Ostigaard.

WP_DP_HP07A_MONK_00.Description: A quick death can be a sort of kindness.

WP_DP_HP07B_WITCH_00.Description: Listen closely and you'll hear them drifting through the fog.

WP_DP_HP08A_HEROES_00.Description: They sing the glory of the Slayers of old.

WP_DP_HP08B_PUNK_00.Description: Twin pistols that are barking mad.

WP_DP_HP09A_ASSASSINS_00.Description: Just wait until you hear them laugh.

WP_DP_HP09B_COMMANDO_00.Description: Twin fistfuls of absolute stopping power. Designed for close quarters combat by the Ostian military and adapted for Behemoth hunting by Seismic gunsmiths.

WP_DP_HP09B_COMMANDO_01.Description: A pair of classic Ostian military-grade repeaters built from design schematics that haven't changed in centuries. Effective, reliable, and deadly.

WP_DP_HP10A_CELESTIAL_00.Description: As inevitable as echoes within the Umbral Deeps, and just as unnatural.

WP_DP_HP10A_CELESTIAL_01.Description: Powered by volatile umbral micro-singularities and weird physics.

WP_DP_HP10B_RAIDERS_00.Description: Sometimes you need to stick with what works.

WP_DP_HP11A_ALCHEMIST_00.Description: Perfectly balanced, and all repeaters should be.

WP_DP_HP12A_FROSTWARDEN_00.Description: "Two are an army next to one."

WP_DP_EVENT_SPRING_00.Description: Watch out for that hare trigger.

WP_DP_IRON.Description: A set of Slayer's repeaters forged with iron ore according to time-tested Ostian techniques.

WP_DP_IRON_SONY.Description: Forged using a rare Ostian technique long thought lost.

WP_DP_IRON_XBOX.Description: Forged with rare ores found only in Ostia's Rugabuso Highlands.

WP_DP_OSTIAN_01.Description: Sturdy aetheric firearms designed for heavy use by dedicated Slayers.

WP_DP_OSTIAN_SONY.Description: A pair of modular, aether-powered firearms designed especially for Slayers. These models have a distinctive blue glow.

WP_DP_OSTIAN_XBOX.Description: A pair of modular, aether-powered firearms designed especially for Slayers. These models have a distinctive green glow.

WP_DP_TRIALS_00.Description: A sterling set of repeaters for those who have earned gilded marks on the Island of Trials.

WP_DP_TRIALS_01.Description: A golden set of repeaters for those who have earned gilded marks on the Island of Trials and won the title "Trials Champion."

WP_DP_UNSEEN_00.Description: Designed by the Unseen cult. "When only a snapshot will do."

WP_DP_ARCSLAYER_00.Description: Aether-charged ammo packs never run out when wired with arc-tech.
